featured_reviews.review_text:

She handed me a few crystals and claimed that just holding them would clear my mind. Honestly, all she did was sweet-talk. I had paid in advance for 10 sessions, but after just two, I decided to discontinue. She only refunded half the amount, and since she never gave me a receipt or any formal documentation, I had no grounds to argue. featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. Preeti Lodhavia is an extraordinary professional who has completely transformed my life for the better. Her expertise, compassion, and unwavering support have been instrumental in reshaping my thought process and guiding me out of the depths of depression.

From our very first meeting, I felt at ease with Dr. Lodhavia. She created a safe and non-judgmental space for me to open up about my struggles and challenges. Her ability to listen attentively and understand my emotions allowed me to confront my issues and work through them constructively.

Through her thoughtful guidance and personalized treatment, Dr. Lodhavia helped me develop coping strategies and practical techniques to manage my depression effectively. Her genuine care and encouragement motivated me to make positive changes in my life, paving the way for a brighter and more fulfilling future.

I cannot thank Dr. Preeti Lodhavia enough for the profound impact she has had on my mental health and overall well-being. Her dedication and expertise make her an outstanding and life-changing professional, and I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone seeking support and healing on their journey to mental wellness.
